<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/auth/setup/restore-dump"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



First-run only: public, and refused with `409` once the server has any
account. Replaces the whole database with one of the dumps listed by
`GET /api/auth/setup/dumps`, chosen by name — there is deliberately no
upload, because the dump's SQL runs as the database role. Pending
migrations are applied afterwards if the dump came from an older Famlin
version. Accounts, passwords and settings come back from the dump, so
no session is issued, and sessions issued before the restore no longer
work: sign in with an existing account afterwards. Rate-limited to 5
requests per 15 minutes per IP.
